gt_provenance.details: outdoor_livinglab_stcm_gt.json contains STCM runtime telemetry (frames_seen, gng_update_calls, raw_detections); no _provenance block, no annotator, no frozen-date, no inclusion protocol. Looks like a frozen STCM output, not hand-annotated GT.

score_normalization.details: Hungarian matching with conventional precision/recall denominators. No fraud. Missing finite-check on NaN/inf poses in _node_pose. No current numeric effect (invalid_prediction_nodes=0).

result_existence.details: F1=0.300 number is honest literal in result file. DSE log row matches. Graph has 21 nodes, max abs pose 12.67m. Harness fragility: run_dse_point.py picks newest matching file rather than capturing exact path.

dead_code.details: DSE swept dead knobs as if live. box_threshold/text_threshold confirmed dead (NYU bank per-class override). target_label_thresholds[trailer] dead but reason mis-stated (GNG manager doesn't read per-label). label_margin_min NOT dead (used in choose_label) - DSE_REPORT was wrong; tied values were coincidence.

scope.details: 20 single-run DSE points on 1 scene with 1 seed. Eval protocol contract requires >=3 independent runs/scenario, recorded git SHA, bag SHA-256, seed, hostname. iter 18 violated all (--skip-bag-hash, dirty git, no seed). Phrase 'best achievable F1' is scope inflation.

label_aliasing.details: Strict same-label scoring gives F1=0.250; declared alias+1.5m gives F1=0.300. Inflation = 1.20x. Extra TP from trolley_GT matched to electric_utility_vehicle_pred at 1.117m via alias. rectangular_table -> trailer alias is most suspect (visually/semantically distinct).

range_gate_bug.details: max_observation_range_m gate computes obs_range without np.isfinite guard. NaN > 5.0 evaluates False, so NaN-pose detections survive. Current iter 18 graph has no non-finite poses, but code path is unsafe before any paper claim. GNG also accepts arbitrary centroids without finite-check.
